boundaryNote: The first month in the URA rolling window may be incomplete.
attribution: Data source: URA private residential transaction data (PMI_Resi_Transaction). Analysis and derived statistics by Groundwork. Contains information made available under the Singapore Open Data Licence v1.0. Not endorsed by URA.
scope: Private Condominium and Apartment, strata, single-unit transactions. New sale, sub-sale and resale kept separate. No Executive Condominiums, no landed.
binUnit: sqft (area converted from URA square metres)
windowSemantics: trailing and cumulative, ending on latestMonth; "all" = full history
periodNote: Disjoint 12-month periods, most recent first; the last entry is the earlier remainder.
floorNote: URA floor bands only. Exact floors are not available and are not inferred.
quantiles: min, Q1, median, Q3, max; linear interpolation between closest ranks
psfNote: PSF is approximate: price / (URA area in whole square metres x 10.7639). Whole-sqm area rounding gives up to about +/-1% PSF error on small units.
monthFormat: Index and detail summaries use "YYYY-MM"; cell arrays use YYYYMM integers.

fields.cellNote: cells: win = window index; periodCells: win = period index; floorCells: win = floor band index; sale 1 new, 2 sub-sale, 3 resale

policy: No exact floors; URA floor bands only
Historical transaction evidence only: no appreciation, yield or forecast
Cells report n, active months and most recent month; evidence sufficiency is decided downstream
Peer cells are context, not project comparables; they include the project itself
